title: 科學級 CCD 成像系統
subcategoryTitle: 天文儀器與科學感測器
summary: 以天文與光譜用的背照式深冷 CCD 為對象，從矽吸收深度與三相時脈的電荷搬運出發，說明為何一個角落像素要經過 8192 次轉移仍不能掉電荷，再把浮動擴散輸出放大器、減薄與深空乏、暗電流溫度律、光子轉移與 Fe-55 增益、像素合併與宇宙射線、多輸出串擾整合成可驗收的相機紀錄。
summaryEn: Using back-illuminated, deep-cooled CCDs for astronomy and spectroscopy, start from silicon absorption depth and three-phase charge transport to show why a corner pixel must survive 8192 transfers without losing charge, then integrate the floating-diffusion output amplifier, thinning and deep depletion, the dark-current temperature law, photon-transfer and Fe-55 gain, binning and cosmic rays, and multi-output crosstalk into an acceptable camera record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」與「電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency" and "Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「背照式矽吸收層」如何決定科學級 CCD 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Back-illuminated silicon absorber” determines the key performance of “Scientific CCD imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 矽的能隙 1.12 eV，可見光光子在矽中產生一個電子電洞對，X 光則平均每 3.65 eV 產生一對，因此 CCD 同時是光子計數器與能量計。前照式 CCD 的光要先穿過多晶矽電極，藍光與紫外在電極中被吸收，量子效率只有四成左右；背照式 CCD 把晶片減薄後從背面受光，加上抗反射膜可在可見光超過九成。但矽對紅光與近紅外的吸收長度很長，900 nm 約 33 µm、1000 nm 約 156 µm，薄元件的紅端效率下降，且前後表面反射形成干涉條紋。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「背照式矽吸收層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Silicon has a 1.12 eV bandgap, so a visible photon creates one electron–hole pair while X-rays create one pair per 3.65 eV on average, making a CCD both a photon counter and an energy meter. In a front-illuminated CCD light must first cross polysilicon gates that absorb blue and ultraviolet, limiting QE to about 40%; a back-illuminated CCD is thinned and illuminated from the back, and with an antireflection coating exceeds 90% in the visible. However, silicon's absorption length is long in the red and near infrared, about 33 µm at 900 nm and 156 µm at 1000 nm, so thin devices lose red response and reflections from both surfaces create interference fringes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Back-illuminated silicon absorber”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：吸收比例 1 − exp(−d/L)：900 nm（L = 33 µm）時厚 15 µm 吸收 37%、40 µm 為 71%、100 µm 為 95%；1000 nm（L = 156 µm）時 15 µm 只有 9%、100 µm 為 47%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Absorbed fraction 1 − exp(−d/L): at 900 nm (L = 33 µm) a 15 µm layer absorbs 37%, 40 µm absorbs 71% and 100 µm absorbs 95%; at 1000 nm (L = 156 µm) 15 µm absorbs only 9% and 100 µm 47%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「背照式矽吸收層」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Back-illuminated silicon absorber”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「科學級 CCD 成像系統」的「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「觀測站：找回微弱訊號」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency: mechanism and system boundary” in “Scientific CCD imaging systems”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Observatory: Recover a Faint Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency" is correct?
options: 背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。
矽的能隙 1.12 eV，可見光光子在矽中產生一個電子電洞對，X 光則平均每 3.65 eV 產生一對，因此 CCD 同時是光子計數器與能量計。
CTE 為 0.99999 已經接近完美，大面積 CCD 不必再擔心。
optionsEn: A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength.
Silicon has a 1.12 eV bandgap, so a visible photon creates one electron–hole pair while X-rays create one pair per 3.65 eV on average, making a CCD both a photon counter and an energy meter.
A CTE of 0.99999 is essentially perfect even for large CCDs.
quiz.explanation: 矽的能隙 1.12 eV，可見光光子在矽中產生一個電子電洞對，X 光則平均每 3.65 eV 產生一對，因此 CCD 同時是光子計數器與能量計。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Silicon has a 1.12 eV bandgap, so a visible photon creates one electron–hole pair while X-rays create one pair per 3.65 eV on average, making a CCD both a photon counter and an energy meter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背照式矽吸收層」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Back-illuminated silicon absorber” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：吸收比例 1 − exp(−d/L)：900 nm（L = 33 µm）時厚 15 µm 吸收 37%、40 µm 為 71%、100 µm 為 95%；1000 nm（L = 156 µm）時 15 µm 只有 9%、100 µm 為 47%。15 µm 厚、n = 3.6 的矽在 900 nm 的條紋間距 λ²/(2nd) = 0.81 µm²/(2×3.6×15 µm) = 7.5 nm，夜天光的窄發射線會產生明顯條紋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Absorbed fraction 1 − exp(−d/L): at 900 nm (L = 33 µm) a 15 µm layer absorbs 37%, 40 µm absorbs 71% and 100 µm absorbs 95%; at 1000 nm (L = 156 µm) 15 µm absorbs only 9% and 100 µm 47%. A 15 µm layer with n = 3.6 has a fringe spacing at 900 nm of λ²/(2nd) = 0.81 µm²/(2×3.6×15 µm) = 7.5 nm, so narrow night-sky emission lines produce strong fringes. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以單色儀與可溯源校正光電二極體做比值法，每 10 nm 量一次 QE 並與吸收模型及抗反射膜設計曲線比較；以 1 nm 步進的窄頻平場或可調雷射照射，量測條紋振幅與間距，反推矽層厚度分布；紫外端在不同曝光歷史下重複量測以檢查 QE 遲滯。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure QE every 10 nm by the ratio method with a monochromator and a traceable calibrated photodiode, comparing with the absorption model and the antireflection design curve; illuminate with narrowband flats stepped by 1 nm or a tunable laser to measure fringe amplitude and spacing and infer the silicon thickness map; repeat ultraviolet measurements after different illumination histories to check for QE hysteresis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 吸收比例 1 − exp(−d/L)：900 nm（L = 33 µm）時厚 15 µm 吸收 37%、40 µm 為 71%、100 µm 為 95%；1000 nm（L = 156 µm）時 15 µm 只有 9%、100 µm 為 47%。15 µm 厚、n = 3.6 的矽在 900 nm 的條紋間距 λ²/(2nd) = 0.81 µm²/(2×3.6×15 µm) = 7.5 nm，夜天光的窄發射線會產生明顯條紋。
knowledge.textEn: Absorbed fraction 1 − exp(−d/L): at 900 nm (L = 33 µm) a 15 µm layer absorbs 37%, 40 µm absorbs 71% and 100 µm absorbs 95%; at 1000 nm (L = 156 µm) 15 µm absorbs only 9% and 100 µm 47%. A 15 µm layer with n = 3.6 has a fringe spacing at 900 nm of λ²/(2nd) = 0.81 µm²/(2×3.6×15 µm) = 7.5 nm, so narrow night-sky emission lines produce strong fringes.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency", which statement holds?
options: 矽越厚越好，因為紅光量子效率一定越高。
增益就是 ADC 位元數除以滿井，不需量測。
吸收比例 1 − exp(−d/L)：900 nm（L = 33 µm）時厚 15 µm 吸收 37%、40 µm 為 71%、100 µm 為 95%。
optionsEn: Thicker silicon is always better because red QE rises.
Gain is simply full well divided by ADC range and needs no measurement.
Absorbed fraction 1 − exp(−d/L): at 900 nm (L = 33 µm) a 15 µm layer absorbs 37%, 40 µm absorbs 71% and 100 µm absorbs 95%.
quiz.explanation: 吸收比例 1 − exp(−d/L)：900 nm（L = 33 µm）時厚 15 µm 吸收 37%、40 µm 為 71%、100 µm 為 95%；1000 nm（L = 156 µm）時 15 µm 只有 9%、100 µm 為 47%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Absorbed fraction 1 − exp(−d/L): at 900 nm (L = 33 µm) a 15 µm layer absorbs 37%, 40 µm absorbs 71% and 100 µm absorbs 95%; at 1000 nm (L = 156 µm) 15 µm absorbs only 9% and 100 µm 47%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「背照式矽吸收層」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Back-illuminated silicon absorber” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以單色儀與可溯源校正光電二極體做比值法，每 10 nm 量一次 QE 並與吸收模型及抗反射膜設計曲線比較；以 1 nm 步進的窄頻平場或可調雷射照射，量測條紋振幅與間距，反推矽層厚度分布；紫外端在不同曝光歷史下重複量測以檢查 QE 遲滯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure QE every 10 nm by the ratio method with a monochromator and a traceable calibrated photodiode, comparing with the absorption model and the antireflection design curve; illuminate with narrowband flats stepped by 1 nm or a tunable laser to measure fringe amplitude and spacing and infer the silicon thickness map; repeat ultraviolet measurements after different illumination histories to check for QE hysteresis. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把薄背照式 CCD 用在近紅外光譜，條紋振幅可達一到三成，若平場與科學影像的照明光譜不同，條紋無法除掉，天光扣除留下週期性殘差；背面鈍化不良時紫外 QE 隨照光歷史漂移，同一顆星的流量前後不一致。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using a thin back-illuminated CCD for near-infrared spectroscopy produces fringes of 10% to 30%, and if flat-field and science illumination spectra differ the fringes do not divide out, leaving periodic sky-subtraction residuals; with poor backside passivation ultraviolet QE drifts with illumination history so the same star's flux changes from frame to frame.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以單色儀與可溯源校正光電二極體做比值法，每 10 nm 量一次 QE 並與吸收模型及抗反射膜設計曲線比較；以 1 nm 步進的窄頻平場或可調雷射照射，量測條紋振幅與間距，反推矽層厚度分布；紫外端在不同曝光歷史下重複量測以檢查 QE 遲滯。
knowledge.textEn: Measure QE every 10 nm by the ratio method with a monochromator and a traceable calibrated photodiode, comparing with the absorption model and the antireflection design curve; illuminate with narrowband flats stepped by 1 nm or a tunable laser to measure fringe amplitude and spacing and infer the silicon thickness map; repeat ultraviolet measurements after different illumination histories to check for QE hysteresis.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency"?
options: 以單色儀與可溯源校正光電二極體做比值法，每 10 nm 量一次 QE 並與吸收模型及抗反射膜設計曲線比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
像素合併只是軟體後處理，任何感測器效果都一樣。
optionsEn: Measure QE every 10 nm by the ratio method with a monochromator and a traceable calibrated photodiode, comparing with the absorption model and the antireflection design curve.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Binning is only software post-processing and works the same on any sensor.
quiz.explanation: 以單色儀與可溯源校正光電二極體做比值法，每 10 nm 量一次 QE 並與吸收模型及抗反射膜設計曲線比較；以 1 nm 步進的窄頻平場或可調雷射照射，量測條紋振幅與間距，反推矽層厚度分布；紫外端在不同曝光歷史下重複量測以檢查 QE 遲滯。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure QE every 10 nm by the ratio method with a monochromator and a traceable calibrated photodiode, comparing with the absorption model and the antireflection design curve; illuminate with narrowband flats stepped by 1 nm or a tunable laser to measure fringe amplitude and spacing and infer the silicon thickness map; repeat ultraviolet measurements after different illumination histories to check for QE hysteresis. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背照式矽吸收層」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Back-illuminated silicon absorber” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把薄背照式 CCD 用在近紅外光譜，條紋振幅可達一到三成，若平場與科學影像的照明光譜不同，條紋無法除掉，天光扣除留下週期性殘差；背面鈍化不良時紫外 QE 隨照光歷史漂移，同一顆星的流量前後不一致。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Using a thin back-illuminated CCD for near-infrared spectroscopy produces fringes of 10% to 30%, and if flat-field and science illumination spectra differ the fringes do not divide out, leaving periodic sky-subtraction residuals; with poor backside passivation ultraviolet QE drifts with illumination history so the same star's flux changes from frame to frame. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：但矽對紅光與近紅外的吸收長度很長，900 nm 約 33 µm、1000 nm 約 156 µm，薄元件的紅端效率下降，且前後表面反射形成干涉條紋。

steps.title: 電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「三相時脈與電荷轉移」如何決定科學級 CCD 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer” determines the key performance of “Scientific CCD imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: CCD 的每個像素是埋入式通道上的 MOS 電容，曝光時光電子被收集在電極下的電位井中。讀出時以三相時脈依序升降相鄰電極的電壓，把整排電荷包一行一行往水平暫存器平移，再一格一格移到輸出放大器。每次轉移留下的比例稱為電荷轉移無效率 CTI，來源是矽中的缺陷陷阱、太空中質子造成的位移損傷與表面態；陷阱先捕獲電子再延後釋放，使影像沿讀出方向拖尾。CTI 在低訊號、低背景時最嚴重，因為沒有其他電荷先把陷阱填滿。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三相時脈與電荷轉移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each CCD pixel is a MOS capacitor over a buried channel, and during exposure photoelectrons collect in the potential well under the gates. Readout raises and lowers adjacent gate voltages with three-phase clocks so whole rows of charge packets step toward the serial register and then, pixel by pixel, to the output amplifier. The fraction left behind per transfer is the charge-transfer inefficiency CTI, caused by bulk defect traps, proton displacement damage in space and surface states; traps capture electrons and release them later, trailing the image along the readout direction. CTI is worst at low signal and low background because no other charge has filled the traps first. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：4k × 4k 元件角落像素需 4096 次平行加 4096 次水平轉移，共 8192 次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A corner pixel of a 4k × 4k device crosses 4096 parallel plus 4096 serial transfers, 8192 in all.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「CTE 為 0.99999 已經接近完美，大面積 CCD 不必再擔心。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A CTE of 0.99999 is essentially perfect even for large CCDs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「三相時脈與電荷轉移」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Each CCD pixel is a MOS capacitor over a buried channel, and during exposure photoelectrons collect in the potential well under the gates. Readout raises and lowers adjacent gate voltages with three-phase clocks so whole rows of charge packets step toward the serial register and then, pixel by pixel, to the output amplifier.

讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。

steps.title: 電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三相時脈與電荷轉移」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：4k × 4k 元件角落像素需 4096 次平行加 4096 次水平轉移，共 8192 次。CTE = 0.999999 時保留 0.999999⁸¹⁹² = 0.9918，損失 0.82%；CTE = 0.99999 時保留 0.921，損失 7.9%。Fe-55 的 1616 e⁻ X 光事件經 4096 次 CTE = 0.99999 平行轉移剩 1551 e⁻，峰值隨列號線性下降 4%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A corner pixel of a 4k × 4k device crosses 4096 parallel plus 4096 serial transfers, 8192 in all. At CTE = 0.999999 it keeps 0.999999⁸¹⁹² = 0.9918, losing 0.82%; at CTE = 0.99999 it keeps 0.921, losing 7.9%. A 1616 e⁻ Fe-55 X-ray event after 4096 parallel transfers at CTE = 0.99999 retains 1551 e⁻, so the peak falls linearly by 4% across the rows. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 Fe-55 放射源均勻照射，挑出單像素事件，畫出事件振幅對列號與行號的關係，斜率除以轉移次數即得每次轉移的 CTI；另用延伸像素邊緣響應法，在平場曝光後讀取過掃描區，量最後一行之後溢出的電荷比例；在不同溫度與時脈電壓下重複，找出 CTE 最佳的操作點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Illuminate uniformly with an Fe-55 source, select single-pixel events and plot event amplitude against row and column number; the slope divided by the transfer count gives CTI per transfer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 4k × 4k 元件角落像素需 4096 次平行加 4096 次水平轉移，共 8192 次。CTE = 0.999999 時保留 0.999999⁸¹⁹² = 0.9918，損失 0.82%；CTE = 0.99999 時保留 0.921，損失 7.9%。Fe-55 的 1616 e⁻ X 光事件經 4096 次 CTE = 0.99999 平行轉移剩 1551 e⁻，峰值隨列號線性下降 4%。
knowledge.textEn: A corner pixel of a 4k × 4k device crosses 4096 parallel plus 4096 serial transfers, 8192 in all. At CTE = 0.999999 it keeps 0.999999⁸¹⁹² = 0.9918, losing 0.82%; at CTE = 0.99999 it keeps 0.921, losing 7.9%. A 1616 e⁻ Fe-55 X-ray event after 4096 parallel transfers at CTE = 0.99999 retains 1551 e⁻, so the peak falls linearly by 4% across the rows.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency", which statement holds?

optionsEn: A corner pixel of a 4k × 4k device crosses 4096 parallel plus 4096 serial transfers, 8192 in all.
Colder is always better; cooling a CCD to its minimum has no penalty.

quiz.explanationEn: A corner pixel of a 4k × 4k device crosses 4096 parallel plus 4096 serial transfers, 8192 in all. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「三相時脈與電荷轉移」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 Fe-55 放射源均勻照射，挑出單像素事件，畫出事件振幅對列號與行號的關係，斜率除以轉移次數即得每次轉移的 CTI；另用延伸像素邊緣響應法，在平場曝光後讀取過掃描區，量最後一行之後溢出的電荷比例；在不同溫度與時脈電壓下重複，找出 CTE 最佳的操作點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Illuminate uniformly with an Fe-55 source, select single-pixel events and plot event amplitude against row and column number; the slope divided by the transfer count gives CTI per transfer. Use extended pixel edge response as well, reading the overscan after a flat-field exposure to measure the charge that trails beyond the last column; repeat at several temperatures and clock voltages to find the operating point with the best CTE. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：太空任務中質子輻射逐年增加陷阱，暗弱星點的流量損失與質心偏移隨在晶片上的位置而變，測光與天體測量都出現位置相依的系統誤差；若只用亮平場驗收 CTE，低訊號的嚴重拖尾直到科學資料才被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: In space, proton radiation adds traps year by year, so faint stars lose flux and shift centroid depending on their position on the chip, creating position-dependent systematics in both photometry and astrometry; accepting CTE with bright flats only hides the severe low-signal trailing until science data reveal it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 Fe-55 放射源均勻照射，挑出單像素事件，畫出事件振幅對列號與行號的關係，斜率除以轉移次數即得每次轉移的 CTI；另用延伸像素邊緣響應法，在平場曝光後讀取過掃描區，量最後一行之後溢出的電荷比例；在不同溫度與時脈電壓下重複，找出 CTE 最佳的操作點。

Use extended pixel edge response as well, reading the overscan after a flat-field exposure to measure the charge that trails beyond the last column; repeat at several temperatures and clock voltages to find the operating point with the best CTE.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 太空任務中質子輻射逐年增加陷阱，暗弱星點的流量損失與質心偏移隨在晶片上的位置而變，測光與天體測量都出現位置相依的系統誤差；若只用亮平場驗收 CTE，低訊號的嚴重拖尾直到科學資料才被發現。
knowledge.textEn: In space, proton radiation adds traps year by year, so faint stars lose flux and shift centroid depending on their position on the chip, creating position-dependent systematics in both photometry and astrometry; accepting CTE with bright flats only hides the severe low-signal trailing until science data reveal it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Read noise belongs to the chip alone and does not depend on readout speed.
